question:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.

One who is a centre of attraction
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e. **'Cynosure'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "One who is a centre of attraction"** refers to someone who draws or garners a lot of attention or interest from others.(ध्यान का केंद्र)
 
• **Cynosure -** which refers to a person or thing that is the center of attention or admiration.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Cynosure'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are explanations for the rest of the words:
 
 
• **Exposure -** refers to the state of being exposed to contact with something, such as a harmful or pleasant environment, or to public attention.(प्रकटीकरण)
 
• **Commissure -** is a term used in anatomy to denote a site of union or junction. (योग स्थल)
 
• **Censure -** refers to the expression of severe disapproval, typically in a formal statement.(निन्दा)
